environment: macOS ARM64, Colima Linux ARM64, direct Docker single-container launch and synthetic Hub
observations: A direct Docker launch reached an authenticated Hub fixture and remained healthy. Only loopback COM was published, three named data volumes were attached, and the mounted credential was copied into a Hermes-owned 0600 file. The synthetic Hub token was absent from logs and container environment. Workflow lint passed. Publishing a live registry manifest and verifying public anonymous pull are post-merge checks.
